## Publishing checklist

- [ ] `status` in the sheet is `rendered`.
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes and `render-report.json` has no error.
- [ ] The caption reads correctly without the video.
- [ ] The source list is complete and the links still resolve.
- [ ] Nothing in the frame reads as a real person or a real product screenshot.
- [ ] The video was watched once, muted, on a phone.
- [ ] Posted by hand — nothing in this repo publishes automatically.
- [ ] `published_url` filled in and `status` moved to `published`.
